## Requirements

1. Visual regression across **every template × {light, dark} × {1440, 390,
   320}** on synthetic fixtures — `SIG-UI-152` stamped in the PR; canvases
   masked (GPU rasterisation is not cross-runner deterministic, K14 R-9);
   every baseline change cites its ticket.
2. **Dark** and **reduced-motion** Playwright projects (DR-K14-13 /
   SIG-UI-147; DR-K14-15 / SIG-UI-149; K14 §4.9–4.10).
3. An **operator gallery** generator writing under `docs/build/logs/` —
   never published (the gitignored build-memory subtree).
4. Synthetic fixtures only — no real names in baselines or the gallery.

## Plan

- Coverage DERIVED, never a hand list: the build's `sig.page-types-manifest/1`
  gains a per-route `component` (the page module) and a `dataSource` field;
  `tests/visual/templates.ts` claims every module into a visual-template
  group; each group shoots one deterministic representative per cell —
  a new `.astro` template lands in the grid by resolution, and an
  unclaimed module fails the sweep loud (K0 NEW-4).
- `web/playwright.visual.config.ts` — six projects
  (`{light,dark} × {1440,390,320}`), `maxDiffPixelRatio 0.01`
  (DR-K14-18's bound verbatim), `animations: "disabled"`, canvas +
  `[data-visual-mask]` masking, one platform-agnostic baseline set under
  `tests/visual/visual.spec.ts-snapshots/` cited by
  `tests/visual/baselines.json` (`sig.visual-baselines/1`).
- `web/playwright.config.ts` — `dark` + `reduced-motion` projects join
  `chromium`/`no-js`; `tests/e2e/dark.spec.ts` sweeps every template
  representative (declared color-scheme, real dark background, axe WCAG
  2.2 AA in dark, print forces light); `tests/e2e/reduced-motion.spec.ts`
  sweeps zero-duration transitions/animations on every representative +
  post-interaction T2.
- `web/src/lib/motion.ts` — the reduced-motion camera guard
  (`prefersReducedMotion()` per-call read; `easeOrJumpTo`, `fitBoundsOrJump`);
  every `MapApp.tsx` camera move routes through it;
  `tests/unit/motion-guard.test.ts` bans bare `.easeTo(`/`.flyTo(`/
  `.fitBounds(` outside the module (the NEW-10 fix: `jumpTo` under reduce).
- `web/scripts/visual-gallery.mjs` — self-contained baseline/actual/diff
  review page → `docs/build/logs/visual-gallery/` (refuses a `dist`/`public`
  target; K14 §7 sign-off wording `prepared_not_executed`).
- `web/scripts/visual-adopt-baselines.mjs` — the sanctioned adoption path:
  `--ticket P…` required, copies CI actuals into the snapshots dir and cites
  the ticket in `baselines.json`.
- CI — `national_budget_leg.sh visual|gallery` subcommands; the `web` job
  runs the grid over the national build the leg already produced, uploads
  actuals on failure (adoption source) and the gallery artifact always.

## Progress

- `page-types.ts` + `astro.config.mjs`: `astro:routes:resolved` metadata is
  collected across BOTH `astro:build:done` invocations (the hook fires once
  for prerendered, once for server routes — the first implementation
  overwrote the earlier collection); route regexes needed trailing-slash
  candidate normalisation before `/about/` etc. resolved. Manifest now
  records `component` + `dataSource`; the build classified **530 routes /
  116 distinct page modules**, every module claimed by the registry.
- `templates.ts` — 95+ groups over the 116 modules (one module → several
  groups where a template renders visually distinct families, e.g. the
  dossier's country/admin1/locality depths via `prefer` discriminators).
- Dark project caught a REAL bug on first sweep: `.sig-explore-picker__btn`
  took the UA dark `buttonface` (`#6b6b6b`), the muted count read 2.28:1 —
  fixed with token surfaces (`islands.css`); 95/95 dark cells now pass axe
  WCAG 2.2 AA + the print-forces-light probe.
- Reduced-motion: all 4 `easeTo` + 2 `fitBounds` MapApp call sites routed
  through `easeOrJumpTo`/`fitBoundsOrJump` (`cameraForBounds` + `jumpTo`
  under reduce — same frame, no easing); 97 tests pass.
- Fixtures smoke run proved the mechanics (screenshots, masking, actual
  capture layout the gallery consumes) — and revealed Playwright writes
  the actual AT THE EXPECTED PATH on a missing baseline: fixtures-rendered
  pngs (real names) landed in the snapshots dir. Deleted; the spec now
  `test.skip`s every shot unless `dataSource: "national"`, so a fixtures
  dist can never render a baseline — the data-source guard still fails red.
- National-build grid validation (same-host): first verify run against
  freshly written baselines showed **37/582 cells diffing run-to-run** —
  traced to `font-display: optional` on the vendored variable font: the
  webfont-vs-fallback swap decision is taken at each first paint, so under
  CPU contention a page renders different metrics on different runs (the
  fallback `<strong>` never synthesises — the visible symptom was bold
  text losing its weight). A warm-cache reload halved the flake set but
  the `optional` window cannot be made deterministic from the test side;
  the fix that held is a `page.route` stylesheet rewrite of
  `font-display: optional → swap` **inside the spec only** — the shipped
  CSS keeps `optional` (the CLS contract), while every grid cell now
  renders the webfont canonically because `toHaveScreenshot` already
  waits on `document.fonts`. Second verify run: **582/582 green**,
  including the previously flaky `/map/` and `/explore/` cells.
- `dossier-sites` marked `optional: true` — `emittedSiteLists` emits a
  `/sites/` list only for a dossier whose site model crosses the list
  threshold; the national fixture emits none, so the family is recorded
  `unemitted` (the designed optional/unemitted cell) rather than failing
  the required-group sweep.
- Baselines are minted on linux: podman runs
  `mcr.microsoft.com/playwright:v1.62.1-noble` (node 24.18.1/npm 11.16.0
  — inside the pinned engine range) over a copied `web/`; the preview
  server needed the repo-root probe files (`uv.lock`,
  `docs/2_canonical_design_spec.md`, `policy/src/policy/data/`,
  `exports/src/exports/data/`) staged beside it. `CI=1` makes missing
  snapshots land as `-actual.png` in `test-results/` — the same artifact
  shape `visual-adopt-baselines.mjs` consumes — so local minting exercises
  the exact sanctioned adoption path (with `--note` now flagging
  provenance).
- Playwright 1.62 note: `reducedMotion` is a `contextOptions` key, not a
  top-level test option — set under `use.contextOptions`.

## Deviations / deferrals

- **Baseline raster stack:** committed baselines are minted on linux/arm64
  in the pinned Playwright container (Chromium + FreeType — the same
  raster family as CI's linux/amd64; canvases are masked, and the
  `font-display` rewrite removes the webfont/fallback variable, leaving
  only glyph-AA edges as potential cross-arch drift, bounded by the 0.01
  diff ratio). If the amd64 runner still exceeds the bound, the designed
  recovery applies unchanged: `visual-grid-actuals` artifact →
  `visual-adopt-baselines.mjs --ticket P37.60` → re-run green.
- **`ci:` pending head-bound read** at commit time — the honest initial
  state per the closeout protocol.
- No `live` leg, no `production` mutation, no operator act performed or
  simulated; the gallery output prints `prepared_not_executed`.
- `make check` (pytest, ~12.9k tests) was still in flight at this entry;
  `tests/ops/test_publish.py` performs a real fixtures `npm run build`
  mid-suite, so `dist/` reverts to fixtures whenever the suite runs — the
  national leg's data-source guard caught exactly this (loud, by design).
